resolved_conflicts.field: structure at the summit (tower or cab)
resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Kootenai County list describe L-4 cabs. WillhiteWeb reports a 1956 USGS party saying the lookout tower had been removed. The story reports both and does not pick one.
Three sites list an L-4 cab in 1945; WillhiteWeb says another cab may have been built that year. The story says the sources differ.
1952 on firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and WillhiteWeb; c.1952 on the Kootenai County list. The story uses 1952 and notes c.1952.

notes_for_editor: The brief has kind 'ground'. Most sources describe an L-4 cab, which fits a cab on the ground, but WillhiteWeb's 1956 note mentions a tower, so the kind is left as is. The access level 'public' is inferred from the forest-road directions and the drive-up description; no source says the summit is open to the public in so many words. The 1940s staffing is a decade only. No photo file was found. The only description of the site today is WillhiteWeb's photo captions: metal from the lookout in the firepit and north views growing over with trees. The 1931 and 1952 dates agree across sources; the 1945 cab does not.
